text.tspan: "Can't expose the pod": follow the chain from outside in; it breaks at one link
Also: NetworkPolicy denying ingress · security group on nodes/pods (NodePort 30000-32767) · kube-proxy / CNI unhealthy
kubectl get pod -l app=web -o wide --show-labels # Running? READY 1/1? labels?
kubectl get svc web -o yaml | grep -A3 selector # does selector match those labels?
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=web # pod IPs listed?
kubectl port-forward pod/web-xxx 8080:8080 ; curl localhost:8080 # app OK directly?
kubectl run t --rm -it --image=busybox -- wget -qO- http://web:80 # Service OK inside the cluster?
kubectl describe ingress web ; kubectl logs -n ingress-nginx deploy/ingress-nginx-controller
kubectl describe svc web # events: e.g. 'Failed to build model' / subnet tags for an LB
Classic causes: label typo, targetPort ≠ containerPort, app bound to 127.0.0.1, readiness failing, ClusterIP used from outside
